collection.description: A humming lavastone has been giving people headaches, and a villager has been asked to break it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A lavastone kept in the village storehouse has been making people uneasy: it hums at night, and two villagers say it gives them headaches. A meeting has decided it should be broken and the pieces scattered in the sea. (subject) has been asked to do it. (subject.He/She) is holding a heavy stone over it, and (friend) is watching nervously.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Everyone it touches feels suddenly, absurdly happy. Villagers laugh for no reason all afternoon. Nobody knows why. The headaches stop.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Several villagers feel dizzy and queasy for the rest of the day, (subject) among them. It passes. The headaches stop too.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) brings the stone down. The lavastone shatters, and a burst of warm light rolls out across the whole village, like a gust of summer wind.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) lowers the stone. "I don't want to destroy something we don't understand," (subject.he/she) says. Some people are relieved. Some are frustrated. In the end, the village agrees to carry the lavastone out to a small rock island off the coast and leave it there, where it can hum all it likes. The headaches stop. Whether that proves anything, nobody can say.
